drafts_today.text: The woman 40+ who takes care of everyone else first deserves a routine that takes three minutes. Gentle cleanser, a good serum, a rich cream, and a sticky note on the mirror that says "you first." #GiftsForHer #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: hands writing 'you first' on a sticky note, pressing it on the mirror, then the three RIMAN steps lined up below it. End card: 'Three minutes. Every day.'

drafts_today.text: The step most of us skip after 40? Your neck and the backs of your hands. Whatever goes on your face goes there too: same serum, same cream, ten extra seconds. They show dry winter air first. #SkinBarrier #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: finish face routine, then sweep the leftover serum and cream down the neck and over the backs of the hands. Caption: 'Don't stop at the jawline.'

drafts_today.text: Monday reset: if your shelf has 12 products and your skin still feels dry, try three for two weeks. Gentle cleanser, one serum, a rich cream. Less to irritate, more room to repair. #FewerProducts #WinterSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: a crowded bathroom shelf, slide everything aside until only three RIMAN products remain. Text: 'Two weeks. Three products. Watch what happens.'
